_about: Settings of the three models (risk, NHANES real-data check, no-show). design = a modelling choice: small, regularised trees because the data are small; seeds make every run repeatable.

cv_folds.source: Folds for cross-validated scores, model checks and recalibration

top_reasons.source: Number of reasons shown with each risk score

ml_second_opinion.source: Switch for the trained second opinion on undiagnosed diabetes (models/ml_risk.py, shown in the Doctor view next to the published FINDRISC score). It is information only: it never changes anyone's priority, so the simulation and every result are the same with it on or off. Switch it off to show the published score alone

care_assistant.source: Settings of the optional Care Assistant (api/assistant.py): a read-only assistant for doctors, outreach staff and the hospital admin, built on the Claude API. It is off unless the server has an API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and the anthropic package, and enabled=false turns it off. It reads only the one record the user opened, can send and change nothing, and never writes a message to a family (approved templates only). model, effort and the limits are design choices; the model and its effort can be changed here

fallback_cutoffs.source: Used only if the risk model card is missing (the real cut-offs come from the score spread)

nhanes_adult_age.source: NHANES diabetes analyses use adults aged 20 and over

nhanes_top_share.source: Strategy compared with the broad rule: invite the top 30% by score

no_score_rank.source: People with no risk score (children, too few records) count as the middle rank in the priority score

undiagnosed_bp_threshold.source: WHO and ESC/ESH: hypertension is blood pressure 140/90 mmHg or more on repeated measurement (average of the NHANES readings)

local_calibration.source: Each score is shifted (intercept only, ranking unchanged) so the average over local adults without that diagnosis matches the expected undiagnosed rate: WHO UAE prevalence (data/real/who) minus the diagnosed share in the records, capped at the published undiagnosed share (config/synthetic_data.json)
